universalAnswers.whatHappened: Anthropic released Opus 5.5 and announced API prices plus separate subscription-limit changes.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: A model release with different billing and use-limit implications for developers and subscribers.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: No account UI, quantified subscription limit or independent benchmark validation is supplied.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A reader can avoid confusing API prices with her monthly subscription and know what access still needs checking.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: Claude subscribers, Claude Code users and developers using the API; exact effects depend on surface and plan.
universalAnswers.changesNow: Published API prices and named subscription-limit changes took effect in the announcement; account-specific access is not established.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Plan-by-plan selector eligibility and individual limits remain unresolved.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Identify the product surface, then check its current model selector or plan details.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: Is this number a monthly plan price, a usage limit or a per-token developer charge?

model-tool-release.productRange: Anthropic calls Opus 5.5 the first model in its Claude 5.5 family and its leading Opus model.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: Anthropic reports capability and efficiency improvements, but this brief does not independently validate or recommend them.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: The source describes complex coding and knowledge work; this article makes no reader-specific task recommendation.
model-tool-release.notFor: The announcement does not make Opus 5.5 a universal choice or establish that every account can select it.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: Anthropic compares it with Opus 5 and other models, but provider benchmarks do not establish the best choice for one reader.
model-tool-release.availability: Anthropic says all platforms and named cloud partners; plan-by-plan chat selector access is not supplied.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: Named paid plans receive higher five-hour limits; the announcement does not establish Free access or identical paid-plan selector access.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: API $4 input and $20 output per million tokens are developer usage charges, not a monthly subscription price.
model-tool-release.limitations: Plan-specific selector access and limit quantities are unresolved; safety and performance statements remain provider claims.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: Benchmark and spectacular coding examples are omitted because they do not answer the reader’s billing question.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: Release, availability, pricing, performance, speed and safety statements come from Anthropic; no independent performance validation is claimed.
